title: Irish Yeasty Boudin Noir Hash
description: A hearty, savory dish that combines the rich flavors of boudin noir with the comforting warmth of hash and the crisp freshness of yeasty bread.
instructions: 2. In a large skillet, cook boudin noir over medium heat, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
3. Add onion, carrot, and garlic to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
4. Stir in hash and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
5. In a separate bowl, mix together bread and a pinch of salt and pepper.
6. Add cooked boudin noir mixture to the bowl with bread and stir until well combined.
7. Transfer the mixture to a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
8. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the mixture is heated through.
9. Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
